jobs.description: CompanyThrough its Rothe Erde, Uhde and Polysius businesses as well as the majority investment thyssenkrupp nucera, Decarbon Technologies delivers innovative, cutting-edge technologies for the transition to a climate-neutral industrial economy. With its solutions for decarbonization, defossilization and the circular economy, Uhde is a technology and implementation provider of large-scale plants for the chemical industry. Polysius supplies green technologies for the cement and lime industry, digital automation solutions, and on-site and remote maintenance services. thyssenkrupp nucera is a global supplier of electrolysis technology for the industrial-scale production of clean hydrogen. In doing so, you will contribute to the effective and consistent implementation of compliance requirements throughout the segment.- You will support compliance reporting at segment and Group level, assist in the development of compliance processes, policies, concepts, and preventive measures, and accompany their implementation in an international environment.- You will monitor and analyze regulatory developments and compliance risks, derive appropriate measures, and support their implementation.- In addition, you will independently manage cross-functional compliance projects and actively drive the further development of the compliance organization and compliance culture within the segment.Your profile- You are passionate about working collaboratively and excited to contribute to the further evolution of Compliance at thyssenkrupp Decarbon Technologies during a period of transformation and growth.- You hold an degree in Law and have successfully completed the Second German State Examination (Second State Exam) or possess an equivalent legal qualification.
